object_rendering: The held object is a separate Cocos Node/Sprite, parented or constrained to the claw attachment point. Never use claw_grab_example.png as a final gameplay sprite.
review_note: 原始三态文件有已知缺陷；项目已采用清理/补边版本，静态短抓手显示见 R6。原图状态不覆盖派生修复批准；三态运行挂点与旋转间隙仍待 1A。
interaction_rules: 仅技能按钮旋转 90°；点击当前物体松手也释放。
UI 触摸不得冒泡触发释放，释放只处理一次。
可操作后开始规划倒计时；首局前两件免自动释放；后台/暂停不计时。
layout: R6 short cable and claw enter from safe-area top; no visible horizontal rail. rail is an unused source catalog entry, not a rendering requirement.
runtime_calibration: Batch 1A checks three-state attachments, lowest Collider point after 90 degree rotation, visible support and release clearance. Initial position follows SPEC 2.2, not PNG canvas dimensions.
